items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The present one, the one that we toured in Japan with was with Jimmy Cobb on drums, David Finck on bass.

ctx.x: No. Buster was part of a later group called The Great Jazz Trio. Buster was in that along with Grady Tate, as the drummer, I believe if I'm not mistaken. But there were several incarnations of The Great Jazz Trio. The present one, the one that we toured in Japan with was with Jimmy Cobb on drums, David Finck on bass.
